related_questions.question: Do I need a visa to Dubai with a US green card?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, a US Green Card holder will generally need a visa to enter Dubai (UAE) for tourism or other purposes. While US citizens can enter Dubai visa-free for short stays, this does not extend to Green Card holders.

list.title: US Citizens:
list.snippet: US citizens can enter Dubai visa-free for stays of up to 30 days.

list.title: US Green Card Holders:
list.snippet: Green Card holders, regardless of their nationality, typically need to apply for a visa before traveling to Dubai.

list.title: Visa Options:
list.snippet: There are different types of visas available for Green Card holders, including tourist visas, business visas, and transit visas.

list.title: Visa on Arrival:
list.snippet: In some cases, Green Card holders may be eligible for a visa on arrival, but this depends on their nationality and the validity of their Green Card.

list.title: Sponsorship:
list.snippet: Typically, a sponsor in the UAE (like a hotel, business, or family member) will need to initiate the visa application process on your behalf.

text_blocks.snippet: In summary, if you are a US Green Card holder planning to visit Dubai, you should plan to obtain a visa through the appropriate channels before your trip.
